gaps: The CCA's general disaster/GBV assertion lacks event, location and period disaggregation; no measured local violence increase or complete supported mediator chain is retained.
A qualitative climate/demographic-emigration projection without a stated period was excluded. No climate-to-interethnic-violence or reverse-FCV pathway is inferred.
Municipal indices use 2020–2021 inputs; hazard rankings are model-based, not observed losses or current household prevalence.
UNDRR scorecards and planned investments describe institutional processes, not published local scores or verified resilience gains.

executive_assessment.text: Named municipalities differ in socioeconomic vulnerability and modeled hazard exposure; these 2020–2021 inputs are not a 2026 local ranking.
Social-protection triggers, contingency finance, health-worker capacity and poorer households' service access shape response readiness.
Gazi Baba, Gjorce Petrov and Ohrid undertook resilience scorecard processes; no published score changes or demonstrated investment outcomes are established.
